full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted the suit against opposite party No. 1 The opposite party No. 2 on his own representation was added as defendant No. 2 in the said suit and others were impleaded as proforma-defendants by the plaintiff. The suit was for declaration of title in the land in suit on the ground that ROR Khatian was erroneously recorded in the name of the Government of Bangladesh, opposite party No. 1. The case of the plaintiff was, in short, that land in suit originally belonged to Zaminder Brajendra Kishore Roy Chowdhury from whom plaintiffs father Jaha Box Bepari took jote pattan an 25th Bhadra, 1351 BS at a rental of Taka 6.00 on payment of najar selami. He got possession of the same on assertion of his title to the knowledge of all. Jaha Box died leaving plaintiff-petitioner as a son and proforma defendant Nos. 3-8 as other heirs. On amicable arrangement with the other heirs of Jaha Box the plaintiff alone got the land in suit and was in exclusive possession therein. His further case was that in the middle part of Falgoon, 1387 BS he learnt for the first time the wrong recording of the land in suit in the name of the Government. Hence the suit.
